Rebalance Sports Medicine is a full service health care facility in downtown Toronto. We are here to help you with all of your body needs. We want to help you feel better and perform better in your everyday lives. Don't learn to live with your pain and don't stop doing the activities you love. Come see us so that you can live better. Our therapists are all experts in their industry and stay up to date on new evidence and the latest techniques for your body. We have a team of skilled physiotherapists, chiropractors and registered massage therapists that work together to improve you health and well being.

This channel is designed to help our clients with information they need in between their sessions so that they can continue to learn about their conditions and build on their exercise skills while they are at home. Please consult your health professional for more information or to see if this content can benefit you.
